options.name: include_parent
options.description: Whether to enable the parent feature and the parent's dependencies.

options.name: name
options.description: The name(s) of the feature to install. This relates to C(FeatureName) in the Powershell cmdlet. To list all available features use the PowerShell command C(Get-WindowsOptionalFeature).

options.name: source
options.description: Specify a source to install the feature from. Can either be C({driveletter}:\sources\sxs) or C(\\{IP}\share\sources\sxs).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to ensure the feature is absent or present on the system.
